$comment: Compatibility sweep round 16 list (compiled by Android compat round 19; measured on the desktop by desktop sweep round 12 on Electron 44.4.5, baseline ff730181; until then no desktop sweep had run for these ranks, the desktop sweep having returned to its regular cadence with round 8): the next 30 Chrome Web Store extensions by install count after the top 30 of round 1, the 30 of next30.json and the 30 of each of next30-round3.json to next30-round15.json (ranks 451-480; manifests under the project store internal/extensions/next30-round16/). Counts are the store detail pages' rounded figures read 2026-09-25; ties inside one rounded bucket are ordered by the page's rating count, equal rounded rating counts by name. Candidates came from the store's category listings and keyword searches, about 24,900 detail pages probed across rounds 3 to 16 (this round added 575 search terms and 2,062 new detail pages; eight of them read the rounded 400,000 bucket or above - Planet Search at 2,000,000 users and 189 ratings, RapidIdentity at 1,000,000 and 32, Connecteur Antidote at 1,000,000 and 164, Soda PDF Viewer at 800,000 and 7, Audio editor online X-Audacity at 600,000 and 192, MSN New Tab at 500,000 and 199, Sea Foam at 500,000 and 1.3K, Passbolt at 400,000 and 105 - counts that would have placed the rankable ones in earlier lists had the store's listings or the earlier rounds' terms surfaced them, so the five rankable ones above the 400,000 bucket are ranks 451-455 as the highest-count items not yet listed, the earlier lists standing as compiled, and Passbolt takes its place inside the bucket by its rating count; the other 2,054 are below the bucket). Every unlisted candidate at or above the rounded 400,000 bucket (71 detail pages) was read again on 2026-09-25, the same day as round 18's list's read; no user count and no rating count moved. Ranks 451-455 are the newly surfaced pages' rankable items above the 400,000 bucket in count order - Planet Search (2,000,000), Connecteur Antidote (1,000,000), Soda PDF Viewer (800,000), Audio editor online X-Audacity (600,000) and MSN New Tab (500,000); RapidIdentity is Identity Automation's form-fill SSO agent for its customers' deployments, organisation-managed as the earlier lists held Okta Browser Plugin and My Apps Secure Sign-in Extension, and Sea Foam is a theme; the rounded 700,000 bucket still holds no unlisted rankable item (Securly for Chromebooks, Idira Identity Browser Extension and Citrix Web Extension organisation-managed, Dark Theme for Google Chrome a theme), nor the 600,000 and 500,000 buckets beyond the two ranked here (Postman a Chrome App, Cegid Peoplenet ClickOnce launcher organisation-managed). Ranks 456-480 are the rounded 400,000 bucket's 25 items with the most ratings after the 18 of next30-round14.json and the 29 of next30-round15.json, and the cut falls between Passbolt - Open source password manager at 105 ratings and EditThisCookie (V3) at 94; no two of the 25 share a rounded rating count. Planet Search is a default-search override (chrome_settings_overrides.search_provider with a popup and a worker, no scripts). Connecteur Antidote is Druide's companion to the Antidote desktop application over native messaging, ranked as earlier lists ranked the native-messaging companions (its core check stops at the application's absence); ExpressKeys declares nativeMessaging beside its own vault. Passbolt signs in to a Passbolt server, Directo and Draftback ask for a Google identity, DocHub's scripts run in Gmail, CS2 Trader's on Steam's trade pages, Netflix Party's on Netflix, Affirm's popup and Perplexity's ask their services - ranked as earlier lists ranked Grammarly and HubSpot Sales. The rows carry the manifests' names, which match the store's listings for all 30. Not ranked: themes (Morpheon Dark, Dark Theme for Google Chrome, Sea Foam), Chrome Apps (Google Classroom, Postman), organisation-managed or organisation-login-only items (the list of round 13's comment - ClassLink OneClick, Clever, Mobility Print, Endpoint Verification, Lightspeed Insight Agent, Okta Browser Plugin, Trellix Endpoint Security Web Control, LearnPlatform for Students, OpenText Content Server Browser Web Extension, My Apps Secure Sign-in Extension, MasteryConnect LockDown Browser, HID Credential Management Extension, Snow Web Application Metering, iboss Cloud Connector, LanSchool Web Helper, Browser Security Plus, Browser Redirection Extension, ActivID CMS extension, Britannica School Insights, Securly for Chromebooks, Idira Identity Browser Extension, Citrix Web Extension, Cegid Peoplenet ClickOnce launcher, iboss Classroom Management for Students - and RapidIdentity) and Google items whose detail pages publish no user count.
